content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question. I am using [product_name] and want to prevent the live display of data (specifically a speed value from a sensor) on a [product_name] operator panel when a particular sensor contact is activated. For example, if the speed sensor reads 100 rpm and then the contact sensor activates, I want the displayed speed to remain fixed regardless of whether the engine's speed changes. I need the speed value to stay unchanged until the contact is deactivated. Thank you. Translated with Google.
I'm sorry, but I don't fully understand your request.

Let me clarify with a more specific example: I have a speed analog sensor and a button. The speed sensor measures the speed of an electric motor, and this value is shown on a display. I want the displayed speed to freeze at the current value when I press the button—so after pressing the button, the display will hold that speed reading, ignoring any further changes from the sensor.
Is this the functionality you're looking for?
Yes, that's exactly what I mean. Thank you very much!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking a way to freeze the displayed speed value at the moment a button is pressed when using [product_name] and a [product_name] operator panel, so later sensor readings do not alter the shown value. The core need is for the display to hold the speed value as a consistent reference until released.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that once the button is pressed, the speed value on the display will immediately freeze and remain visible, unaffected by real-time updates from the speed sensor.
